summary: Tested KeyMind AI backend (16 pytest tests, all PASS) and frontend mobile E2E. Backend: guest auth, /auth/me, logout invalidation, 8 AI tools (grammar EN/Hinglish, paraphrase 3 results, translate→Hindi devanagari, tone, summarize, synonyms, emoji), chat + history persistence, history CRUD, empty-text 400 — ALL GREEN. Frontend: splash→onboarding→SKIP→login→guest signin works; grammar tool returns DIFF view, APPLY updates input + saves to History tab; tab nav (Write/Tutor/History/Settings) all reachable; theme/accent pickers, sign-out, premium CTA render. BUG: Login useEffect race redirects guest user to /(tabs) instead of /setup, so the post-login Setup screen is bypassed entirely (it was only shown when launched via index.tsx because storage was empty). Minor: deprecated 'shadow*' & 'props.pointerEvents' RN web warnings (cosmetic).

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping CONTINUE AS GUEST the Setup screen is skipped. The useEffect on lines 27-31 calls router.replace('/(tabs)') as soon as `user` becomes non-null, racing/overriding the router.replace('/setup') inside handleGuest (line 84). Per spec, guest sign-in must route to /setup on first launch. Fix: in the useEffect, gate the /(tabs) redirect by checking storage.getItem('keymind_setup_done') === true (mirroring app/index.tsx logic), or only auto-redirect when busy === null. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:27-31 and :79-89

Cosmetic: line 309 computes `opts` with lowercased target_language but then passes `pendingOptions` (raw) to runTool on line 311 — unused variable. Not blocking (backend accepts 'Hindi' fine), but dead code. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:307-312

issues: Tab label reads 'YOU' instead of 'SETTINGS'; harmless but minor inconsistency with spec wording. Touch targets and contrast OK.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props emit console warnings on web. Migrate to React Native's `boxShadow` (RN 0.76+) or wrap behind Platform.select. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.ts (SHADOW.brutal / brutalSm)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a Modal/View. Search for `pointerEvents=` and move into style. Cosmetic only.

action_items: FIX login.tsx setup-screen bypass: either remove the auto /(tabs) redirect when keymind_setup_done is false, or set a 'busy' guard so handleGuest's router.replace('/setup') wins (HIGH).
Clean up dead `opts` variable in (tabs)/index.tsx:309 or pass it through (LOW).
Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` in /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.ts.
Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with style.pointerEvents wherever used.

rca_of_issue: Setup-screen-skip bug RCA: In /app/frontend/app/login.tsx, handleGuest() (line 79) does `await signInAsGuest()` then `router.replace('/setup')`. signInAsGuest updates AuthContext.user state. Concurrently the component's useEffect (line 27) watches `user` and immediately fires `router.replace('/(tabs)')`. React's render order means the effect's redirect runs right after state propagation, overwriting /setup. Reproduction: clear storage → onboarding skip → tap CONTINUE AS GUEST → app lands on /(tabs)/index instead of /setup. Mitigation: in the early useEffect, guard with `if (!loading && user && (await storage.getItem('keymind_setup_done', false))) router.replace('/(tabs)')`. Or set a local `signingIn` flag during handleGuest and bail out of the effect while it's true.
